title: nbn 25/10 $48.99/Month Ongoing (No Contract & Price Lock Until Dec 2027) & Free eero 7 Router with 24-Month Plan @ Arctel
body:
Deal: nbn 25/10 $48.99/Month Ongoing (No Contract & Price Lock Until Dec 2027) & Free eero 7 Router with 24-Month Plan @ Arctel

[MrZ] What's the Australian definition of broadband?
[Team Triforce] Ouch @MrZ, got more negative votes than us for once! 🤣
[SydBoy] That is not correct. I use 25mbps since last 4 year I think and no problem at all having multiple devices working at home.
[Mjk698] Well tell NBNco to fkn upgrade those of us stuck in the 90s on the old copper FTTN…. I'm only 100km from the CBD and stuck on FTTN and lucky to get 25mbps… Not like I'm 500km in the Bush…
[PLA74] Hi rep, did the eero 7 hardware prices go up recently?
3 pack showing $298 + $20 shipping now. Thanks.
[Team Triforce] Hi Mate,
They are back up to $149… unfortunately like all hardware providers, eero have hiked the pricing on us due to the component shortages.
All we have done is reflect the new price, as our existing stock had run out :(
Thanks,
H
[PLA74] Any deals you’re able to offer on 2 or 3 Eero devices bundle purchase please? Very keen to sign up.
[Team Triforce] Why not… use this - “OZB-EERO-10%” for an extra discount on any upfront routers until the 31/07/2026!
Code will be live in 20 minutes, have to get someone from marketing out of bed 😎
[seanbaussie] Umm… Can anyone give a real scenario where someone on 25/10 needs wi-fi 7?
[Team Triforce] I can give you scenarios where someone with 500/50 doesn’t need WiFi 7. It’s also about the coverage, as well as speed.
[seanbaussie] LoL, I'll be sure to let my grandma know.
I did a bit of research I'll pass on too.
With MU-MIMO, wireless routers use different spatial streams to allow simultaneous data transmissions, offering increased performance for applications such as video streaming and online gaming. And TWT helps conserve battery life in client devices by allowing them to remain in a sleep state until they need to access the network. The Wi-Fi 7 standard builds on these (and other) existing Wi-Fi 6 and Wi-Fi 6E technologies, while bringing a few new technologies into the fold.
[Team Triforce] Its optional, nobody asked you or your grandma to buy one 😎
[edrift] Any long term deals on 500/50 plans please?
[Team Triforce] Something brewing… not sure how much I can share here just yet?! It’s going to be got existing customers first though… 😉
[edrift] Thanks great to hear. I've been with you guys almost 12 months and my promo pricing is coming to an end. Hoping for another deal so I don't need to churn
[Team Triforce] Hang in there, we are launching a massive retention program next month! Will be worth the wait… & thanks for your business!
[itsfree] Just wanted to give my 2¢: I switched my brother over to Arctel from It's Fubar a few days ago, using a scheduled connection date. Everything switched over seamlessly, and we didn't even notice the connection drop. Sign up was easy and customer service has been pretty good. Much better than my horrendous experience with Amaysim.
[Team Triforce] @itsfree - Awesome to hear! We are here to please, we honestly struggled in the start as the response was way over our expectations.
We won’t always get it right, but we are here to make it as smooth as possible.
[Team Triforce] If you’re already on this plan, you don’t need to do anything for the price lock! We are looking after the loyal customers first, something different hey? 😎
[Doogan] Are you guys planning on having a better static IP setup, I hear everything appears located in Sydney rather than closer to the user?
[Team Triforce] @Doogan - Not correct, currently we distribute public IP’s from pools in NSW/VIC & WA. QLD is overdue, but will also be online shortly.
If you are not in one of those states, you may be assigned an address from your nearest state / our aggregating state.
Hope that clears it up for you.
[ritisav] How much for a static IP? And how do I get one?
[Team Triforce] Hi, it’s $5 p/Month. Drop us a ticket at support@arctel.com.au & the team will get it actioned for you.
[OzDorgain] Been with you guys for a long time now and haven't had any issues at all, went with the $80 -1000/100 plan and the $5 a month for static IP.
Forget the haters, you've got the best value in Australia and I plan on staying so long as the prices remain stable.
Cheers guys 👍👍
[Team Triforce] Love your support @OzDorgain! We have a super special deal coming for existing customers… we are working hard to make sure we reward our loyal customers!!
[exceladdict] Would sign up for this now to avoid the inconvenience of churning!
[Ezekiel2320] No Arlo was spun off from Netgear back in the day. Amazon owns Eero (eww)
[Team Triforce] Don’t eww… eero has been better thank D-Link for us 🤞🏽
